question: 先不看两两比较了——改成看整体：咱们覆盖的这批美股，平均市盈率现在大概什么水平？
answer:
[1] 关键金融指标：  
- 平均市盈率（Average PE Ratio，或平均市盈率）

[2] 可能的计算公式：  
平均市盈率 = 覆盖股票市盈率之和 ÷ 覆盖股票数量  
即：  
\[
\text{平均市盈率} = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n} \text{每只股票市盈率 (PE Ratio)}}{n}
\]
其中，n 表示覆盖的美股数量。

first_sql:
SELECT 
    b.CNAME AS `股票名称`,
    b.COMB_SYMBOL AS `股票代码`,
    a.F001D AS `报告期截止日`,
    b.INDUSTRY_SW_L1_NAME AS `申万一级行业`,
    ROUND(a.PE_RATIO, 2) AS `市盈率`,
    a.F005V AS `货币`
FROM (
    SELECT 
        t1.FIU_ID, 
        t1.F001D, 
        t1.F005V, 
        -- 计算TTM市盈率: 总市值/TTM归母净利润
        CASE 
            WHEN t2.TTM_EARNINGS IS NOT NULL AND t2.TTM_EARNINGS <> 0 THEN 
                ROUND(t3.MARKET_CAP / t2.TTM_EARNINGS, 2)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS PE_RATIO
    FROM (
        -- 最新报表期的FIU_ID、F001D、F005V
        SELECT 
            FIU_ID, 
            F001D, 
            F005V
        FROM COM3102 c1
        WHERE F001D = (
            SELECT MAX(F001D) 
            FROM COM3102 c2 
            WHERE c2.FIU_ID = c1.FIU_ID
        )
        GROUP BY FIU_ID, F001D, F005V
    ) t1
    LEFT JOIN (
        -- 获取TTM归母净利润
        SELECT 
            FIU_ID, 
            SUM(NET_PROFIT) AS TTM_EARNINGS
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                FIU_ID, 
                F001D, 
                -- 请用你对应的字段替换 NET_PROFIT为归母净利润字段（示例名，真实字段请用详细字典），以下假设F062N（所有股东权益）非净利润，若有归母净利润字段请替换！
                0 AS NET_PROFIT
            FROM COM3102
            WHERE F001D >= DATE_SUB('2026-03-31', INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND F001D <= '2026-03-31'
        ) tnp
        GROUP BY FIU_ID
    ) t2 ON t1.FIU_ID = t2.FIU_ID
    LEFT JOIN (
        -- 获取最新总市值
        SELECT 
            FIU_ID, 
            -- 请用你对应的字段替换 MARKET_CAP为最新市值字段（示例名，真实字段请用详细字典），以下假设没有直接市值字段
            0 AS MARKET_CAP
        FROM COM3102
        WHERE F001D = '2026-03-31'
        GROUP BY FIU_ID
    ) t3 ON t1.FIU_ID = t3.FIU_ID
) a
JOIN AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN b ON a.FIU_ID = b.FIU_ID
WHERE a.PE_RATIO IS NOT NULL
